text.p: Portuguese bonds rallied in lively trade after Spain released some details of its stringent 1997 budget.
Dealers said the domestic market would follow any downward correction in Spanish bonds next week but they expected yield differentials with 10-year Bonos to remain at around zero.

The escudo closed stronger at 101.67/77 per mark compared with 101.77/80 after a quiet session on the currency markets. Dealers said any further rise could be blocked by the dollar's strength against the mark. Overnight/tomorrow next rates eased to 7.15/28 percent from 7.20/25 percent at the previous close.
